### Let Jesus Lighten Your Load
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-february-1-2018.html
Passage: Matthew 11:28-30
Points:
- Jesus invites all who are exhausted and weighed down to come directly to Him.
- A yoke connects two draft animals together to share and halve the heavy load.
- Christ does not add new burdens to us, but enters in to share and bear our stress.
- Being yoked with Jesus means learning from Him and walking at His direction and speed.

### Come to Me
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/modern-classic/come-to-me/
Passage: Matthew 11:28
Points:
- Human pride often resists the simple, humbling invitation to come directly to Jesus.
- Our hesitation to approach Christ reveals the areas where we are not spiritually real.
- Coming to the Lord requires allowing the Holy Spirit to remove internal obstacles.
- Christ waits with untiring and gracious patience for us to receive Him.
